research_notes: Identify early teaching schools/payrolls, music clients, sewing and image-consulting entities, individual hours and leave. Resolve duplicate music descriptions and concurrent work/study; obtain Zoe appointment/pay evidence and exact executive departure.

2026-09-29 initial research used APH indexed official chronology, member biography and maiden speech, Zoe Support 2019 annual report and local pupil alumni story. Zoe 2018 report timed out; LinkedIn returned no readable content. No access restrictions bypassed.

Targeted school/music/seamstress/full-time searches found multiple overseas and Australian namesakes; their employment histories were not imported. Red Cliffs Secondary College is a pupil's school in the source, not a verified employing school for Webster.

Zoe annual report documents stepping down, successor arrangements and patron role but not individual hours/pay. Its 2012 service commencement differs from APH's 2011 founder period; both retained without altering dates to produce a total. Board experience is mentioned but complete organisation-level governance chronology remains a lead.

Secondary reporting identifies Mallee Accommodation and Support Program board service from 2005 and chair tenure; targeted employer-domain search did not retrieve a confirming primary record. Follow historical MASP reports. Social-worker label may describe Zoe work and must not become an invented additional employer spell.

Known overlapping year ranges cannot be added. Missing employer control and hours remain unknown, not public/private zero. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; blocked record requires later systematic evidence follow-up.

2026-10-02 follow-up located MASP2010 annual-report board biography (public indexed mirror), Zoe2017 annual-report indexed biography and Webster-coauthored2014 Early Childhood Australia article. Added MASP governance and2006 concurrent degree start; captured2010 full-time study snapshot without applying it to employment.

Remaining: actual teaching employers, seamstress and image-consultancy trading entities, hours/pay and breaks; MASP resignation/chair dates and Zoe employment basis. Targeted searches mostly namesakes; no new supported school employer. Zoe2018PDF timeout,2017ACNCblob404, LinkedIn999 and ParliamentVictoria transcript inaccessible; indexed primary extracts and accessible coauthored article used. Do not endlessly repeat these failed URLs without new leads. Last follow-up2026-10-02; unresolved, totals null.

2026-10-03 follow-up: Mildura Rural City Council's dated Australia Day award notice observes Webster as Zoe Support founder and executive director on 26 January 2019, materially bracketing the transition to patron shown in the employer's 2019 report. This does not identify the departure day, pay or hours and is not used to infer full-time work. Fresh searches for teaching schools, music clients, seamstress/image-consulting entities and MASP chair/end dates returned only previously captured material or namesakes. Record remains blocked; totals null.

2026-10-04 follow-up: exact-name Mildura searches for music teaching, seamstress and image-consulting work returned the existing general biography, current member page and unrelated namesakes. No school/client, trading entity, appointment, hours, leave or payroll evidence surfaced. Generic web search is exhausted for this pass; historical local directories, school records, business registrations and contemporaneous advertisements remain the targeted avenues. Zoe executive evidence was not revisited because the prior pass already bracketed it to 26January2019 and the employer report; no substantive fact changed.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Official parliamentary index adds previously unrecorded AMusA qualification, attributed there to University of Melbourne; timing and attendance remain unknown. Index also reports2011 Lachlan Macquarie Internship Scholarship, but an award alone does not establish attendance, placement employer or salaried internship. Current own biography lists Australian Company Directors Institute ambiguously, without identifying a course, role or dates; retained as a clarification lead, not an invented appointment. Direct APH fetch403Forbidden, indexed official text used transparently. Targeted full-time Zoe query refers to a client’s full-time study, not Webster’s work. Next: AMusA examination record, identifiable AICD role/course, scholarship placement confirmation, early work employers and hours.
